description: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission and the Startup Procurement Scheme 2026, which aims to expand government procurement opportunities for eligible startups, with direct procurement of up to ₹50 lakh.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath , on Friday approved the Uttar Pradesh Artificial Intelligence Mission (UP-AIM), with targets to support at least 100 AI startups , train five lakh AI-skilled youth and develop artificial intelligence applications for governance and public services. The Cabinet also approved the Uttar Pradesh Startup Procurement Scheme, 2026, which seeks to expand market access for startups by enabling government departments to procure innovative solutions directly, subject to eligibility conditions and prescribed limits.
